# Bootstrap 5.3.8

Official compiled Bootstrap CSS and JavaScript bundle, included locally.

- Project: https://getbootstrap.com/
- CSS: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css
- JavaScript: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
- Integrity reference: https://getbootstrap.com/docs/5.3/getting-started/introduction/
- License: MIT, reproduced in LICENSE.

The JavaScript bundle includes Popper. Source maps are not required to run this static application.
